deadline.value: The spring 2027 application period is 12-25 January 2027; the programme admits new researchers twice a year.

also.quote: The programme admits new doctoral researchers twice a year

gre_subject.value: The Biomedicine pages do not mention a GRE Subject test.

supervisor.value: Applicants need one to three supervisors who hold a doctorate, and the supervision arrangements go in the application.
supervisor.quote: Applicants must have one to three supervisors who have themselves completed a doctoral degree

funding.value: Applicants must confirm first-year funding at the application stage; the page does not say admitted students are funded.
funding.quote: Funding for the first year, beginning on the start date of the study right and covering both the applicant’s living expenses and project costs, must be confirmed at the application stage

entry_route.value: Applicants need a second-cycle (master's) degree or an equivalent foreign education.

notes: Research fields listed on the programme page include molecular neuroscience, so neuro is listed here. No separate neuroscience PhD is on the page.
